We want to live - why?
Who's to say?
We don't want to die - why?
Who is to say?
Such questions grace
Our thoughts with the trace
Of the comely face
That wills the ways
Of nights and days
And how they go
From seed to soil
Through sun and snow.
And still remains the question,
Why?
Well... the apple in the eye.
